fusions.name: Rammed Home
fusions.desc: A driving thrust that deals 13 damage, knocks the target back 3 tiles and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Nailed to the Ledge
fusions.desc: Drives a spike through the target, dealing 30 damage that ignores armour, leaving it [Pinned] for 3 seconds and [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Bristling Stance
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 60% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Dig In
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once on a shield that soaks 7% of your maximum health per stack (42% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
